mission_07: Borderline-SMOTE is a variant of SMOTE that focuses on generating synthetic samples only for minority class instances that are near the decision boundary (borderline samples). It first identifies minority samples that are misclassified by a k-NN classifier, then generates synthetic samples only around these borderline instances. This targeted approach avoids generating samples in safe regions where the minority class is well-separated, leading to more efficient oversampling. In this mission, you will apply Borderline-SMOTE to an imbalanced dataset with overlapping classes and compare its focused approach with regular SMOTE.
